rooftops.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent panoramic backdrop layer for Halloween Android music app. A continuous charming haunted village skyline, crooked Victorian cottages, several peaked roofs, one slender distant castle tower, sparse bare twisting tree silhouettes, a few warm amber lit windows. Wide 3:1 landscape PNG 1536x512. True 16-bit console pixel art authored as a native 288x96 pixel scene and enlarged nearest-neighbor: clean hard square pixels, a restrained 12-color palette, no fake pixel texture, no antialiasing or blur, no gradients. Smoked purple #49345F distant shapes, aubergine #31223E foreground, muted lavender highlights, warm amber windows #FFB65A. Entire upper third empty transparent sky, architecture along lower edge with varied roof heights, transparent outside silhouettes; bottoms sit on image lower edge. No moon, no stars, no bats, no characters, no text, no solid background, no frame. Music content will be placed below this strip. Elegant airy layered skyline rather than a dense illustration.
